page.overview:
Who is Baron Vladimir Harkonnen?

Baron Vladimir Harkonnen is the corpulent, ruthless leader of House Harkonnen who engineers the fall of House Atreides.

Also known as: Baron, Vladimir Harkonnen, the Baron.
